description: Implementation class for processing interest posting on savings accounts, including calculation of interest based on account transactions, handling of overdraft and interest posting periods, and tax withholding logic. It manages interest calculation periods, transaction adjustments, and summaries for savings accounts within the Fineract microfinance platform.

classes.name: SavingsAccountInterestPostingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing interest posting logic for savings accounts, including interest calculation, transaction posting, and balance recalculations.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Main method to post interest up to a given date, handling interest calculations, transaction creation, and summary updates.

methods.name: calculateInterestUsing
methods.description: Calculates interest periods and interest amounts based on account data and configuration, generating a list of posting periods.

methods.name: getStartInterestCalculationDate
methods.description: Retrieves the starting date for interest calculation based on account data.

methods.name: getActivationLocalDate
methods.description: Gets the account activation date which may be used as a fallback starting point for interest calculation.
